push.title: Bahre̱ Webhooks - pus liḍs ar nawatet’
push.intro: webhook reaḱ mit́ṭen purạte ạḍi jạruṛaḱ : JSON , Form (x-www-form-urlencoded), se apnaraḱ ạḍi jạruṛaḱ hoṛmo ḍạr sãote <fieldkey></fieldkey> jaega ḍạrko (jeleka <example></example> ) - mit́ dhao cURL hukum bạṛti lạgit́ leka kạmi kana.
push.curlLabel: Apeak̕ gạkhuṛ CRM reak̕ cURL paste me
push.curlHelp: Onkoaḱ API docs se Postman oka nạmuna ko em ocoet́kan ona reaḱ nạmuna paste me (asli se nạmuna data sãote). URL , method ar header ko do̠ oka leka menak̕ ona lekage copy hoyok̕ kana, ar ho̠ṛmo̠ renak̕ sanam key latar re em akana onate am do̠ bachao daṛeak̕a oka CRM field re sanam lead lạgit̕ ona do̠ pe̠re̠ć hoyok̕a.
push.curlManual: Ona bo̠do̠l te̠ apnar te̠ seṭer me̠
push.curlPrompt: Client reak̕ cURL menak̕a ? <action>cURL khon import</action> kate noa peṛeć ar map ḍạrko apnar tege peṛeć me.
push.urlVariables: URL hõ bạṛti kạmi hoyoḱa, jeleka <urlexample></urlexample> .
push.headersInvalid: He̠ḍar do̠ sạri JSON hoyoḱ jạruṛa, jeleka {{example}}
push.authTitle: Pạtiạo ( Leadrat cet́ leka akoaḱ API re̱ sain in kana)
push.modeSame: Joto ghoṭna mit̕ URL re ko kol me
push.modeCreateUpdate: Mit̕ dhao rikoḍ benao me, ar ona tayom ona rikoḍ update me (uniak̕ sec̕ khon ḍupliket do̠ bạnuk̕a)

push.responseIdHint: Okare ID do̠ onkoak̕ JSON reply re̠ menak̕a ona do̠ benao reak̕ ardas re̠. Mit̕ lead re <externalid></externalid> lekate bańcao akana.

api.title: Amak̕ API - Jahae Sisṭem lạgit̕ Bar-Tạr-Aṭkar
api.intro: Amak̕ API key sãote jahan system ge lead benao, paṛhao ar update ar lead ghoṭonako lạgit̕ sạkhyạt hatao daṛeak̕a. <hdr></hdr> hạṭiń re chabi ko kol me, <bearer></bearer> lekate, se (jodi kạmi lạgit́ kạmiạko do bako set́ daṛeaḱ khan) <query></query> lekate. Simạ: {{limit}} mit́ minit re̱ nehọr.
api.noPermission: Eken okoe hõ seṭing bebosta ạidạri menaḱtae API key ńel daṛeaḱa.
api.shownOnce: Nit do̠ noa chabi copy kate jahan jaega re̠ ạḍi sạri ge̠ dohoe me̠ - ạḍi sạri lạgit́ do̠ e̠ke̠n mit́ dhao̠ ge̠ udugaḱa. Jodi ona do̠ ạḍi jạruṛ gea, tobe nãwã do̠ benao me.
api.regenerateConfirm: Nawa API key benao me? Niạ key do̠ ona beohar reaḱ sanam system lạgit́ usạrate kạmi do̠e bạgi oṭoak̕a.
api.openApiHint: OpenAPI spec do̠ Postman , Zapier , me̠k se̠ n8n re̠ ạgu kate̠t̕ sanam mucạt̕ hạṭiń beohar lạgit̕ tear hoyok̕a.
